description_en: Invoke this API to create a promotion activity for the Qianli Chuanyin sharing job
description_zh: 调用该接口创建千里传音分享任务的促销活动
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-share-promotion-activity --share-promotion-activity-name task01 --iot-instance-id iot-cv300000000 --start-time 1691547072000 --end-time 1694315533000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSharePromotionActivity

parameters.description_en: The name of the promotion activity.
parameters.help_en: The name of the promotion activity
parameters.name: share_promotion_activity_name

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must pass this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to pass this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
